name: Handcrafted Bidri-ware cufflinks (blackened zinc alloy with silver inlay), 1 pair, gift-boxed
supplier_cost_note: No supplier price found for Bidri cufflinks as of 2026-11-26. Two searches surfaced no Bidar (Karnataka) wholesale or IndiaMART/TradeIndia listing specific to Bidri. The only B2B cufflink prices seen were for generic metal or silver cufflinks (IndiaMART category pages, about Rs 205-700 per pair per the search summary, https://m.indiamart.com/impcat/metal-cufflink.html, seen 2026-11-26). Those are NOT Bidri and are not used as cost. Need a written per-pair quote from a Bidar artisan or cooperative covering silver inlay content, size, gift box, MOQ, single-pair dispatch and GST basis.
retail_observed: Specialist/D2C only (WebSearch snippets seen 2026-11-26): Goswadeshi handmade Bidri pure-silver-inlay square cufflinks, 1.65 x 1.9 cm, Rs 1,299 incl. tax, shipping extra; Exotic India round 1-inch Bidri inlay cufflinks USD 58 (shown marked down to USD 46.40); The India Craft House Bidri leaf cufflink set and Gaatha Bidri cufflinks (out of stock), prices not shown. Amazon.in/Flipkart/Meesho price UNVALIDATED: three searches surfaced no Bidri cufflink listing there. Generic brass/alloy cufflinks on Flipkart are a commodity (FashMade brass Rs 77, Yellow Chimes Rs 359, Voylla brass set Rs 779 per snippets seen 2026-11-26).

risks: No supplier cost, so recommend.py will reject until a quote arrives. To pass at Rs 1,199 the landed cost likely needs to be at or below about Rs 320 (~27% of price). Real silver inlay and handwork may push Bidar cost above that

Generic cufflinks are a commodity on Flipkart (Rs 77-779). Buyers may not pay a craft premium unless the listing clearly shows Bidri work. Marketplace absence of Bidri rests on three searches, not proof
'Pure silver inlay' and 'Bidri/GI' claims need supplier evidence (policy require_evidence_for_claims). Do not claim silver purity without a test report or supplier declaration
Niche, occasion-driven product (weddings, formal gifting). Volume is unknown and probably low. Cufflinks only suit French-cuff shirts
Small item: lost or swapped-parcel disputes are possible. Needs a sealed gift box and tamper-evident packing. Hinged toggles can arrive bent
Not apparel under the policy (jewellery/accessory, no size or fit), but the review agent should confirm that 'men_accessories' is acceptable since it is not a preferred category
Supplier state unknown. Bidri is a Bidar, Karnataka craft, so the supplier is almost certainly outside Odisha, which means website-only under docs/05
GST: assumed 3% (HSN 7113/7117 jewellery). If classified as an article of zinc/base metal it could be 12-18%. CA to confirm
